eyebrow: One shared Python vs. one per project

code:
python -m venv .venv

# Windows (PowerShell)
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1

# macOS / Linux
source .venv/bin/activate

deactivate   # leave the environment
caption: Your prompt shows (.venv) once the environment is active.

code:
pip install requests
pip install requests==2.31.0   # pin a version
pip list                        # what's installed
pip uninstall requests
caption: Pin exact versions for reproducible installs.

code:
python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"
# should point inside .venv,
# not your system Python
caption: A common bug: code runs against the wrong, unactivated Python.

subtitle: Capturing an entire environment's packages in one file.
